title: BioIVT: Specimen Collection form assembled from the Short Form
description: Creates a Specimen Collection form (SPECCOL) on the same events as the Short Form and moves kit number, collection date, collection time and the post-mortem flag onto it. The kit number and post-mortem question stay hidden for animal donors; the form reads the 'Is this a Human subject?' answer from the Short Form on the same event, and if that lookup returns nothing the questions show rather than hide. Studies without a Short Form are untouched.
rationale: Part of unjumbling the Short Form (BioIVT Option C, Phase 1). Every moved question is recorded in study_meta.field_lineage. Approved by Dan.
